title: nflverse release CDN unreachable from this environment
detail: Every asset under github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases redirects to release-assets.githubusercontent.com, which is outside the egress allowlist. injuries_2026, depth_charts_* and snap_counts_* could not be downloaded.
impact: Injury history limited to 2025; no depth charts; no snap shares. Blocks R14 and weakens R13.
mitigation: Used the 2025 injury file via a third-party mirror (D06) and stated it everywhere it is used.
fix: Allowlist the host, or add a scheduled action that mirrors the releases into this repo.

title: No authoritative depth order in the official roster feed
detail: nfl.com/teams/<team>/roster lists players with status ACT/RES and a jersey number, but no depth sequence. Verified on the Seahawks page (S06).
impact: The 2nd/3rd/4th-string requirement cannot be met from any source reachable here.
mitigation: Reported QB changes only, labelled 'different starter' by start sequence, never as a claimed depth slot.

title: closing_lines.csv records no push outcome
detail: The outcome column is 0/1 only. A bet landing exactly on the number is recorded as a loss, which biases any hit rate computed from that file.
impact: Would have overstated vig and understated hit rates.
mitigation: All push-aware math uses games.csv raw margins instead. Pushes are excluded from both numerator and denominator.
fix: None needed for this repo; note it for any future use of that file.

title: rosters.csv stops at the 2019 season
detail: The roster file contains 2006-2019 only, despite living in the current nfldata repo.
impact: Starter/backup identification by games-started share is impossible for 2020 onward.
mitigation: Not used for any 2020+ claim. Reported here rather than substituted with an estimate.
fix: Use weekly_rosters (release asset, blocked by FLAG-01) or a licensed source.

title: NFL Personnel (Injury) Report Policy full text is a 404
detail: operations.nfl.com/updates/the-operations-report/nfl-policy-on-injuries/ returns a 404 page. Several secondary sources cite it. Multiple guessed paths also 404.
impact: The exact reporting deadlines could not be confirmed from an official page in this session.
mitigation: The status definitions used here are supported by S01 (observed data) and C01 (the 2016 policy change), not by the missing policy text.
fix: Locate the current canonical URL, or obtain the PDF from NFL Communications.

title: 2026 season is incomplete in the source
detail: games.csv has 2026 spreads through Week 11 but results only through Week 10, and Week 10 has only the Thursday game completed (1 of 14).
impact: No 2026 out-of-sample result is possible. Any 2026 number is descriptive.
mitigation: Every performance figure on the site is labelled with its season range and the split date.

title: Mixed team-code generations in the source
detail: SD/LAC, STL/LA/LAR, OAK/LV and WAS all appear across seasons.
impact: A naive join silently drops or duplicates matchups.
mitigation: Normalised in scripts/lib.py::norm_team and in every merge key.

title: Only closing prices are available, not openers
detail: games.csv carries the closing line. initial_lines.csv covers 2021+ only and is not a full-sample opening series.
impact: Model-vs-market edges are measured against the price we would have to beat, which understates any real opening-line edge and cannot test line-movement strategies at all.
mitigation: Every ROI is labelled 'vs close'. No steam or closing-line-value strategy is claimed.

title: 'Removed from both numerator and denominator' changes the gate denominator
detail: Pushes are excluded from ROI denominators. For spreads at whole numbers this can shift the breakeven hit rate slightly upward relative to a raw average.
impact: Small, but it makes the reported breakeven marginally conservative rather than generous.
mitigation: Documented here and in every script docstring.
